intro: Moonglade is an introductory rite of passage for young night elf druids learning to commune with the sacred lands of Kalimdor. Guided by Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, novices learn the spell to magically transport themselves across the world into Moonglade to meet Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven. This marks the beginning of their spiritual journey toward mastering the strength of the bear form.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All druids are welcome in the sacred lands of Moonglade, regardless of the current tensions in the Cenarion Circle between Arch Druid Staghelm and Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian. Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.
As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

clips.title: Completion
paras: "And so it begins, Father Cenarius. And so it begins."
Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.

"The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!"
